makerbit.connectUltrasonicDistanceSensor: Start one background sampler for this HC-SR04. Call once in on start.
makerbit.ultrasonicDistanceAvailable: True when three recent valid echoes support a distance.
makerbit.getUltrasonicDistance: Return whole cm/inches. No setup: -1. No usable reading: 300 cm / 117 inches.
makerbit.isUltrasonicDistanceLessThan: Unknown distances never satisfy this test.
makerbit.onUltrasonicObjectDetected: Fires on arrival; requires a confirmed distance over the threshold plus 5 cm to re-arm.
makerbit.onUltrasonicApproach: Fires at or below enter; re-arms only above reset. Reset must exceed enter.
makerbit.setUltrasonicWindow: Choose how many actual ping attempts to keep. Both settings require three fresh echoes.
makerbit.ultrasonicCount: Count actual triggers, accepted echoes or trigger intervals over 155 ms, since startup.
